access_used: public sample in paper/repo/card only (full data needs the MAD request form + signed NDA)
note: Annotations and CLIP features are released only after a Google form and a signed NDA, and the movies are never released, so no real annotation file was retrieved. The one example is the verbatim pair of grounded audio-description sentences the paper prints for "A Quiet Place" (Figure 2); the file format (one JSON per split) is described in the repo but not shown.

examples.title: A Quiet Place: two audio-description sentences grounded in the full movie (paper Figure 2)

timeline.text: Bearded dad is carrying his other sick son. Mum seems alone with her thoughts and the daughter is in complete silence.
Mum hangs up the laundry outside the farmhouse.

Caption: Example from our MAD dataset. We select the movie "A quiet place" as representative for our dataset. As shown in the figure, the movie contains a large number of densely distributed temporally grounded sentences.
